verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird's own Reach page lists its offices across several countries: Casablanca, Sydney, Beijing, Hong Kong, Shanghai and Singapore, including a named Singapore entity. Practice pages back this up with cross-border reach: a London-based VC practice active across Europe and known in Asia and the US, one of Europe's largest UPC patent teams, and an international trade mark team. Together these show a founder could expand abroad without hiring a second firm. Missing for 10: a complete list of countries and offices (only an excerpt is evidenced), explicit confirmation that founder-relevant practices such as corporate, employment and incentives are qualified in each jurisdiction, and independent corroboration beyond accolades quoted on the firm's own site.
